changelog: Seven HUD themes: Night Drive, Minimal, Racing, Classic, Compact, Tactical and Glass
Pick the on-foot theme and the car cluster separately, plus their own clusters for motorcycles, bicycles, boats and aircraft
Settings menu with live HUD previews, no screenshots: what you see is the real HUD
Health, armor, hunger, thirst, stamina and stress on every theme, with exports for other scripts
Car cluster with speed, rpm, gear, fuel, engine damage, seatbelt, lights, lock, cruise and turn signals on real keys
Weapon panel with clip, reserve and ammo pips, on foot and in the vehicle
Player info block you can trim line by line: name, job, ID, cash and bank
HUD color, size, opacity, minimap shape, minimap only in vehicle and per-element toggles
Move elements mode: drag any part of the HUD where you want it and save
QBox, QB-Core, ESX, ox_core, ND_Core and standalone, 12 languages set in the config
